strings.TrafficBar es una barra flotante para Wi: TrafficBar is a floating bar for Windows that shows and controls what happens with your Internet connection: how pages load, who is tracking you and which programs use your network. It works with all browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Opera, Brave…).
strings.Ver cómo se carga una página, conexión p: See how a page loads, connection by connection, and CUT the load with one click (useful against pop-ups and chained loads).
strings.Bloquear publicidad y rastreadores conoc: Block known ads and trackers, and know how many there were on each page.
strings.Entender el tráfico de tu equipo: qué pr: Understand your computer's traffic: which program talks to which server and how much data it moves, in plain language.
strings.Recibir alertas cuando algo inusual sube: Get alerts when something unusual uploads a lot of data or a new program connects.
strings.Buscar en hasta 5 buscadores desde la pr: Search with up to 5 search engines from the bar itself.
strings.Todo ocurre en tu equipo. TrafficBar no: Everything happens on your computer. TrafficBar does not send your data to any server and has no telemetry.
strings.1) El PROXY LOCAL (botón ⏻). Cuando lo e: 1) The LOCAL PROXY (⏻ button). When you turn it on, TrafficBar sits between your browsers and the Internet. That is how it can measure page loading, block domains and generate the privacy report. When you turn it off, Windows recovers its previous setting.
2) The NETWORK MONITOR (📡 Traffic button). It uses Npcap to observe the packets entering and leaving the computer, from ANY program, even if it does not go through the proxy (download managers, updates, games…). It needs Npcap and administrator rights.
strings.Lo que TrafficBar puede y no puede hacer: What TrafficBar can and cannot do
strings.HTTPS: TrafficBar NO descifra las página: HTTPS: TrafficBar does NOT decrypt secure pages (it installs no certificates). On HTTPS it blocks by server name; content filters (pop-ups, scripts…) only work on HTTP.
strings.Los nombres de destino que ves los decla: The destination names you see are declared by the program or the owner of the IP; the IP itself is real.
strings.Bloquear publicidad casi no reduce los d: Blocking ads barely reduces the data used: its value is privacy and cleaner pages. The real weight is in videos and images from the sites themselves.
strings.TrafficBar no es un antivirus ni un cort: TrafficBar is not an antivirus or a firewall: it informs and filters, it does not replace those programs.
strings.1. Enciende ⏻: la barra pasa a «ON» y e: 1.  Turn on ⏻: the bar switches to “ON” and the button turns green. Now your browsers go through TrafficBar (you may need to restart the browser the first time).
strings.2. Navega con normalidad. La barra de c: 2.  Browse normally. The loading bar fills while pages load. Click it to unfold the panel with every connection.
strings.3. ✂ Cortar: si una página abre ventana: 3.  ✂ Cut: if a page opens pop-ups or never stops loading, press ✂. All connections in progress are cut and new ones are rejected for 4 seconds.
strings.4. 📋 Informe: al terminar una carga te: 4.  📋 Report: when a load finishes it gives you a privacy grade (A–F), with the trackers found. You can block domains or “Allow” those that break a page.
strings.5. 📡 Tráfico: instala Npcap (npcap.com): 5.  📡 Traffic: install Npcap (npcap.com) and open TrafficBar as administrator. You will see each program, who it connects to, how much it uploads and downloads, and the DNS queries. The total shown is what really went through your network card.
strings.6. 🚫 Bloquear un programa: en 📡 Tráfico: 6.  🚫 Block a program: in 📡 Traffic, right-click its row → “Block Internet access…”. TrafficBar creates Windows Firewall rules (1 hour, 4 hours or until you unblock it). Blocked programs are listed and released in 🚫 Blocked. It never blocks Windows components or TrafficBar itself.
strings.7. 🕘 Historial: sitios visitados, consu: 7.  🕘 History: visited sites, usage per program and ALERTS (sustained uploads, new programs). The orange number shows unread alerts.
strings.8. 📅 Cuota mensual: clic derecho en la: 8.  📅 Monthly quota: right-click the bar → “Monthly data quota…”. Enter the GB of your plan and the day your cycle starts: you will see what you have used, what is left per day and whether you will go over at this pace. It warns you at 80 % and 100 %.
strings.9. 🛡 Filtros: elige qué bloquear (domin: 9.  🛡 Filters: choose what to block (domains, pop-ups, sound…). You can download block lists, add your own domains and exceptions, and turn on “Measure only” to see how much data would have been saved without blocking anything.
strings.10. Buscador: escribe y pulsa Enter. Con: 10. Search: type and press Enter. With the ▾ menu you change engine or search all at once (Shift+Enter). Edit up to 5 engines.
strings.11. Herramientas: 📊 Estadísticas · 🧹 Lim: 11. Tools: 📊 Statistics · 🧹 Clean temporary files · 🗺 Site map · 📶 Ping / Traceroute · ℹ Site information.

strings.13. El botón ◂ tiene 3 pasos: grande → m: 13. The ◂ button has 3 steps: large → medium (compact) → fully collapsed (pill); a click on the pill opens it again at large size. Right-click: text and window size, dock at top or bottom, auto-collapse, start with Windows.
strings.14. Cerrar la ventana solo oculta la bar: 14. Closing the window only hides the bar: TrafficBar stays in the system tray, next to the clock. To quit completely, use the tray icon → Quit.
strings.15. 🌐 Idioma: clic derecho en la barra →: 15. 🌐 Language: right-click the bar → “Idioma / Language”. You can load more language packs (.json) or export the template to translate TrafficBar into your language.

strings.El total de una descarga es mayor que el: The total of a download is larger than the file size: network headers add 5–6 %, and some download managers repeat parts of the file.

strings.Monitor y filtro de navegación y de red: Browsing and network monitor and filter for Windows: a floating bar that works with all browsers, shows page loading, blocks ads and trackers and explains your computer's traffic.
strings.• Todo se procesa y se guarda en tu equ: •  Everything is processed and stored on your computer. No accounts, no telemetry, no automatic updates.
strings.• Puedes borrar el historial cuando qui: •  You can delete the history whenever you want (🕘 History).
strings.• El proxy solo acepta conexiones de es: •  The proxy only accepts connections from this computer, uses a random port and limits sizes and times. It was checked with a battery of attack and regression tests (see SEGURIDAD.md).
strings.• Los ejecutables no están firmados dig: •  The executables are not digitally signed: Windows SmartScreen may warn you when installing.
